credits: Original pixel art for Verdant Reach, hand-pixelled in tools/art/crystal/flytrap.py. Reference photo venus_flytrap/adult.jpg by Daniel Atha (iNaturalist: danielatha) (CC0), https://www.inaturalist.org/observations/318289358: used as a drawing reference, not traced. Drawn under the Crystal rule (docs/CREATURES.md); no sprite from any other game was copied, traced or imported.
notes: Gesture: the jaws gape, gape wider, HOLD (20 ticks), SNAP shut and the cilia bristle twice, then ease open. Learned: the shut trap needs a black seam and interlocked white cilia to read as a mouth and not a pod; the bristle frame is the same shut head with the cilia 2-3px longer and splayed. Sport: 'Akai Ryu'.
